notes: Part d, strip x 5380-7120 with overlap to 5080-7420. Grid is rotated slightly: N-S streets drift about -0.06 px in x per px of y. Section Avenue runs straight from Ross (6195,100) to its south end (6020,3243), crossing the Norwood and B&O railroads at grade with no street junctions between Ross and Foraker. Crown, Maple and Elm each jog at Section (two T points each). Montgomery is labelled MONTGOMERY with AVE printed further north-east on the same road (not ROAD). Crown's east leg shows ST, its west leg AVE. Allison's suffix read from a faint 'ST' near (5600,4520). Station Avenue's south leg (x about 7405-7435) is just past the 7420 overlap edge but included. Norwood Avenue lies north of the B&O tracks and has no junction in this strip. Lawrence meets Montgomery at about (7540,4670), outside the overlap, not picked.
